title: ever DANICA|High-Slit Waist Pleated Off Shoulder Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress with Long Sleeves
descriptionHtml:
Make a statement with this chic and modern off shoulder chiffon bridesmaid dress. The long sleeves provide coverage, while the high slit adds a hint of drama. The A-line silhouette and waist pleats flatter the figure, making it perfect for a contemporary bridal party.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Long Sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
